2609.07180.title: Deep Learning for Biopsy-Free Subtyping of Basal Cell Carcinoma from Dermatoscopic Images
2609.07180.paper_summary: Basal Cell Carcinoma (BCC) is the most common type of skin cancer, accounting for nearly 80% of skin cancer di- agnoses. Its optimal clinical management is guided by the distinct histopathologic subtype, with aggressive variants requiring more drastic measures. In current clinical practice, subtyping relies on skin biopsies, a procedure both costly and invasive. In this paper, we conduct a preliminary investigation into using deep learning for BCC subtyping, solely from a single dermatoscopic image of the lesion. Given the limited data at our disposal, we employ pre-trained vision transformers (ViTs), a state-of-the-art family of models highly effective for challenging downstream tasks with limited labeled data. Through repeated stratified k-fold cross-validation, we demonstrate that ViTs can achieve superior performance (AUC 0.784 on a dataset of 1271 dermatoscopic images of various BCC subtypes) over standard CNN-based baselines as well as previously-reported human reader perfor- mance, on the task of differentiating aggressive BCCs from other subtype families. These initial findings highlight the potential of combining deep learning and dermatoscopy to provide a biopsy- free alternative for BCC subtyping, thus aiding in improving treatment planning and patient outcomes.
2609.07180.paper_summary_zh: 基底細胞癌（BCC）是最常見的皮膚癌類型，佔皮膚癌診斷的近80%。其最佳臨床管理受到不同組織病理亞型的指導，具有侵襲性的變異型需要更為激烈的措施。在當前的臨床實踐中，亞型分類依賴於皮膚活檢，這是一個既昂貴又具侵入性的程序。在本文中，我們對使用深度學習進行BCC亞型分類進行初步研究，僅從病變的單一皮膚鏡圖像中進行分析。考慮到我們手頭的數據有限，我們採用了預訓練的視覺Transformer（ViTs），這是一類在有限標記數據的挑戰性下游任務中極為有效的最先進模型。通過反覆的分層k-fold交叉驗證，我們證明ViTs在將侵襲性BCC與其他亞型家族區分的任務中，能夠實現優於標準CNN基線及先前報告的人類讀者表現的卓越性能（在1271張各種BCC亞型的皮膚鏡圖像數據集上AUC為0.784）。這些初步發現突顯了結合深度學習和皮膚鏡檢查的潛力，以提供一種無需活檢的BCC亞型分類替代方案，從而有助於改善治療計劃和患者結果。
